column3: if - The Abominable Kirino Chapter
And so, what happened after accompanying the annoying Kirino was..
Whoa... Isn't this just barely worksafe?!
I was in the middle of playing the games I was forced to buy today... But this is so barely worksafe, it's stunning.
You use this to awaken fickle otakus?!
To be honest, I totally didn't feel like playing.
But if I don't play them, there will be a next time.
When you think about it, you would have to be quite scary to be playing this type of game casually.
Now I understand how you could play inappropriate games with the living room's television...
Hey--!
Whoa... This is really cruel!
Hey! I said listen up!!
Huh? What?!
We're out of shampoo! Bring me the refill pack!
Alright, alright! Might as well. Umph...
Are you listening?!
I'm bringing it now!
In the first place, why do I, who was being made to play, have to be the one to bring it...
But, has Kirino ever relied on me for something like this up till now?
And she's even in a terribly good mood, it seems.
Hey, I brought... it...
WHOAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!
W-Why are you trying to look at your own naked sister?! You pervert! Bastard!! Die!!!
You're the one who told me to come!
Shut up, pervert!!
Like I said, you called so I came!
Forget that! How long are you going to be standing there?!
O-Oh, alright!
Shampoo!
Here.
Hurry up and get out!
You don't have to tell me that!
Pfft, bleah, urgh. I don't want to see my sister naked!
*sigh*... It's been a really tough day. Geez, time to sleep.
Wait a sec!
Yes?! What is it?!
The shampoo! Thanks!
O-Okay!  ...Wait. Kirino thanked me? Really?!
